headline: Island Clashes Flare On Lykos As Central Fronts Settle Into Attrition
war_summary: In the three hours since the previous dispatch, frontline base captures have concentrated in Lykos Isle, where two further shifts struck Astutia and neighboring islets, while the ferocious churn across Fisherman’s Row and the Linn of Mercy has sharply cooled into a quieter posture. Dead Lands registered fresh mid-evening changes at Abandoned Ward and Callahan's Boot before steadying under relentless attritional fire. Stlican Shelf remains bitterly contested around Thornhold despite slowing turnover, while Godcrofts holds calm following earlier fighting at Lipsia. Meanwhile, immense attrition persists without immediate territorial exchange across Weathered Expanse, where thousands fall each hour, and across Loch Mor and Clahstra, where casualty rates are accelerating rapidly along reinforced sector boundaries.
